visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt and grey shorts is walking away from the camera on a paved path in a park. A hand enters from the side to tap his shoulder. He turns around to face the camera. The setting is a lush green park with a wooden pavilion in the background under overcast natural daylight. (2) The man jumps energetically in the air while holding a smartphone. The screen displays a colorful interactive app with illustrations. He stands on the path, gesturing towards the screen and speaking directly to the camera with high facial arousal and excitement. The background shows green trees and a winding brick-edged walking path. (3) Two young women, one in a blue striped shirt and one in a white top, stand together in the park. They look slightly bewildered and talk to each other while glancing off-camera. Both are wearing small black lavalier microphones on their shirt collars. The camera captures them from a medium shot against the greenery. (4) A series of fast-cut clips show the man interacting with the women. One woman is seen laughing and crawling on the grass in a playful manner. The man holds up a row of Mahjong tiles towards the lens. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout these outdoor park scenes. (5) The group is now at an amusement park. The man is seated on a swinging pirate ship ride, screaming and looking distressed while attempting to deliver lines to the camera. The background is filled with the motion of the ride, colorful park structures, and a small lake with colorful boats. (6) The three of them are seen on a drop tower ride, their faces showing extreme excitement and fear as the ride plummets. Finally, they stand together in front of a large red and white robot statue at the amusement park entrance, pointing towards the camera in a coordinated promotional pose.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Interaction -> Educational Content Delivery -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional campaign for an interactive game called '愛の回憶疏通師' (Memory Unlocker), which serves as an educational tool for HIV awareness. It uses high-energy comedy and amusement park challenges to deliver the medical message 'U=U' (Undetectable = Untransmittable), encouraging people to play the game to learn about the lives of those living with HIV.
